meta.name: add-anydoc
meta.description: Add local office-document-to-Markdown conversion to NanoClaw agent containers with the pinned Firecrawl AnyDoc CLI. Use when agents need to read attached Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF files without uploading them to a hosted parser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让你的智能助手直接读懂本地各类办公文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的智能助手需要读取本地办公文档却不便上传到云端
copy.tagline_en: Let your AI agent read local office documents directly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI agent to read local office docs without uploading them.

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 的 agent 容器装上 Firecrawl AnyDoc CLI 和一个转换技能，让 agent 能把本地的 Word、PPT、Excel、PDF 等附件转成 Markdown 来读，文件不上传到托管解析器。
howto.when: 当 agent 需要读取附加的 Word、Excel、PDF 等文档，且不想把它们上传到托管解析器时，该技能在容器内完成本地转换。

say.text: 把这个附件里的 Word 文档转成 Markdown 并总结要点
say.note: 在容器内本地转换，不上传

say.text: 把这份 Excel 表格转成 Markdown，只列出预算相关的部分
say.note: 表格 Markdown 不作为计算依据

say.text: 确认这份扫描版 PDF 能不能转换
say.note: 扫描件需要 OCR，会明确失败

howto.what_en: Installs the pinned Firecrawl AnyDoc CLI and one container skill so NanoClaw agents convert attached Word, PowerPoint, Excel and text-based PDF files into Markdown locally, without uploading them to a hosted parser.
howto.when_en: Triggers when an agent needs to read attached Word, Excel, PDF and similar office documents without sending them to a hosted parser; conversion runs inside the agent container.

say_en.text: Convert the attached Word file to Markdown and summarize the key points.
say_en.note: Runs locally in the container; nothing is uploaded.

say_en.text: Turn this spreadsheet into Markdown and list only the budget rows.
say_en.note: Spreadsheet Markdown is not authoritative for calculations.

say_en.text: Check whether this scanned PDF can be converted.
say_en.note: Scanned PDFs need OCR and fail clearly.
